response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT st.zoneregistry AS sitecode, st.healtheval AS status, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avgratio, COUNT(*) AS scancount FROM scans sc JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY st.zoneregistry, st.healtheval), meanavg AS (SELECT AVG(avgratio) AS meanratio FROM grp) SELECT g.sitecode, g.status, g.avgratio, g.scancount, g.avgratio - m.meanratio AS excess FROM grp g CROSS JOIN meanavg m WHERE g.avgratio > m.meanratio ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
